name: Jindal Poly Films Limited
summary: Jindal Poly Films Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells biaxially oriented polyethylene terephthalate (BOPET) and biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films in India and internationally. It operates through Packaging Films, Nonwoven Fabrics, and Others  Coated Products segments. The company offers BOPP, thick and thin BOPET, CPP, lamination, metallized, coated, thermal lamination, and capacitor films. It also provides polypropylene-based spunmelt and spunbond nonwoven fabrics for the hygiene, medical, and industrial sectors; labelling solutions; and tear tapes, stamping foils, security threads, and other products.
